name: Shillong and Cherrapunji
summary: The Scotland of the East: pine hills, waterfalls, living root bridges and the wettest places on earth, close to Bangladesh's Sylhet border.
season_note: October to April is dry and clear; waterfalls are strongest in June-September but roads can be bad.
avoid_note: Heavy monsoon causes landslides near Cherrapunji.
entry_note: Indian visa is required for Bangladeshi passport holders (apply via the Indian Visa Application Centre, usually medical/tourist/e-visa categories as currently offered). Check the latest rules with the embassy before booking.

reach.how: Dhaka to Guwahati (Biman, US-Bangla, IndiGo, Air India)
reach.note: Then 3.5 hours by road/cab to Shillong. Check direct options.

reach.how: Dhaka to Sylhet then Tamabil-Dawki border to Dawki and on to Shillong (via Dawki/Shillong road)
reach.note: Dawki-Tamabil border crossing; check if open for tourists.

reach.how: Dhaka to Sylhet then taxi via Tamabil

attractions.name: Elephant Falls
attractions.what: A three-tier waterfall near the city.

attractions.name: Nohkalikai Falls and Mawsmai Caves
attractions.what: One of India's tallest waterfalls and a limestone cave.
attractions.tip: Clear mornings give the best view.

attractions.name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge
attractions.what: A hiking day to an ancient living root bridge in the jungle.
attractions.tip: Over 3,000 steps; start early, wear grip shoes.

attractions.name: Dawki and Umngot River
attractions.what: Crystal-clear river with boat rides on the Bangladesh border.
attractions.tip: Best in the dry months; boat per boat price.

attractions.name: Umiam (Bara Pani) Lake
attractions.what: A reservoir with boating and water sports.

attractions.name: Shillong Peak
attractions.what: The highest viewpoint with view of the city.

attractions.name: Police Bazar
attractions.what: The central market for shopping and street food.

attractions.name: Don Bosco Museum
attractions.what: Museum of Northeast India's tribes and cultures.

rules: Respect Khasi tribal culture; ask before photographing people.
Alcohol is legal but drinking in public is frowned upon.
Plastic bag use is restricted in parts of the state.
Root bridge hike: stay on marked trails.
